We utilize exact match (EM) and partial match (Overlap) F1 scores as metrics on MultiSpanQA, and exact match percentage and macro‑averaged F1 score on SQuAD and Quoref. To assess factual consistency we used Q2, an automatic metric that employs question generation and answering methods.

Following the conventions of the datasets' official leaderboards (listed in A.1), we employ exact match (EM) and partial match (Overlap) F1 scores as metrics on MultiSpanQA, and exact match percentage and macro-averaged F1 score on SQuAD and Quoref.
